item.title: Breaking KASLR with CLDEMOTE: From Paper to PoC
item.description: I recently came across a paper by Taehun Kim et al. — “Demoting Security via Exploitation of Cache Demote Operation in Intel’s Latest ISA Extension” (arXiv:2503.10074) — that caught my attention. They proposed two attack primitives built on Intel’s CLDEMOTE instruction: Flush+Demote (a covert channel) and Demote+Time (a KASLR bypass). The KASLR part was what interested me the most, so I decided to build my own proof of concept and test it on a real cloud environment.
